title: Open to all
slide_intent: Introduce partnership as a relationship that must be identifiable in a communication. Readers need to recognize both the organization speaking and the affiliation it claims.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give partners a way to acknowledge collaboration while retaining their distinct identity.
demonstration: A full-page street photograph carries the partnership introduction and a large stacked campaign headline near the center-right.
practical_value: Use this opener to frame the distinction the following pages will specify: partner affiliation and shared authorship require different identifiers.

content_islands.name: Partnership introduction
content_islands.spec: Overlay the chapter rail and short introductory copy on the darkened left edge of the photograph.

content_islands.name: Photo and headline
content_islands.spec: Extend the photograph across the page. Place the three-line headline on pink strips with the hand-drawn accents near the people in the scene.
